title: Check wrangler D1 sign-in
question: SA1 got Cloudflare error 7403 on its only D1 query. In Terminal run: npx wrangler whoami, then npx wrangler d1 execute meridian-etf --remote --command "SELECT 1". If either fails, run npx wrangler login. Needed before the baseline queries, and the local jobs (FIRDS Sun 15 Nov) use the same sign-in.
reply: Reply "wrangler ok" or paste the error (no tokens)
answer: wrangler ok — SELECT 1 on meridian-etf --remote succeeded from repo root (no -c); SA1 7403 attributed to -c wrangler-entities-enrich.toml
